fr.name: Chin-up (supination)
fr.description: Traction mains en supination, paumes vers toi. Les biceps travaillent davantage qu’en pronation.
instructions: Suspends-toi à la barre, paumes tournées vers toi, mains à la largeur des épaules.
Gaine le corps et garde les jambes immobiles.
Tire en amenant la poitrine vers la barre jusqu’à passer le menton au-dessus.
Redescends lentement jusqu’à avoir les bras tendus.
commonMistakes: Écarter les mains trop largement, ce qui gêne les poignets.
Remonter avant d’avoir les bras tendus en bas.
fr.mediaAlt: Chin-up (supination) : personne suspendue à une barre, paumes vers elle, menton au-dessus de la barre.

en.name: Chin-up
en.description: A pull-up with an underhand grip, palms facing you. The biceps work more than with an overhand grip.
instructions: Hang from the bar with your palms facing you, hands shoulder-width apart.
Brace your body and keep your legs still.
Pull your chest towards the bar until your chin clears it.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
commonMistakes: Placing the hands too wide, which strains the wrists.
Swinging the legs to get up.
Starting the next rep before the arms are straight at the bottom.
en.mediaAlt: Chin-up: a person hanging from a bar with palms facing them, chin above the bar.
